cv.note: folds loaded from split/split.csv via cv_folds.load_split; noise floor measured with RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x5) on train only

noise_floor_basis: simple LogisticRegression on 7 numeric + 3 categorical honest features, median/most-frequent impute, PR-AUC
fixed_steps: drop churn_reason, account_status_code from features (presumed leak, confirmed Stage 3)

features.name: final_8_features_no_region_no_lastinvoice
features.note: region and last_invoice_amount dropped on Stage 6 ablation evidence; 3 engineered features (interaction, frequent_caller, residual) dropped, no gain beyond noise

models.name: logreg
models.reason: best family by a wide, noise-floor-clearing margin over dummy and shallow tree; near-converged learning curve (train~0.21, val 0.156->0.215)

models.name: catboost
models.reason: best of the 4 boosted trees screened (vs lightgbm 0.1405, xgboost 0.1342, hist_gbm 0.1252) despite scoring below logreg's automated tolerance; learning curve shows severe overfitting at default settings (train PR-AUC 0.94-1.00 vs val 0.13-0.16), i.e. variance-limited not signal-limited - carried into the Stage 8 tuned search on the judgment that regularization (depth, l2_leaf_reg, iterations) may close some of the gap; a manual override of the automatic screen, logged here as required by Non-negotiable #3

models.name: lightgbm
models.reason: dominated by catboost among trees; dropped to keep the Stage 8 search space small given the 60-trial/10-minute compute cap

models.name: xgboost
models.reason: dominated by catboost among trees; same reason as lightgbm

models.name: hist_gbm
models.reason: weakest of the boosted trees screened, and slowest in this environment (44.6s/5-fold vs 8-15s for the others)

imbalance_handling: class_weight balanced / scale_pos_weight (SMOTE screened, no gain - see imbalance_screen.csv)
